author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell reacts to the arrest of activist Daniel Thompson after he allegedly slashed an empty migrant dinghy following a confrontation near British waters, before questioning whether moments like this have a kind of “psyop energy” that keeps ordinary people angry, divided and choosing sides. He argues that while everyone fights over the latest controversy, centralized systems continue expanding in the background.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Andy Burnham promises to build the Britain his father wanted to see—but Russell sees something increasingly familiar: another carefully manufactured political product. From the sentimental family story to the perfectly timed applause, he asks whether changing the person at the top can really fix Britain when the system underneath remains exactly the same.
